claims: The term "flop" originated in the early 17th century (circa 1602) as an alteration of the word "flap".
"Flop" initially described the sound or action of falling.
The informal "failure" meaning of "flop" evolved later.
In poker, the flop is the first three community cards dealt face-up in games like Texas hold 'em.
In basketball, particularly the NBA, a flop is an attempt to get a foul called on an opponent by exaggerating contact.
LeBron James has been fined for flopping in basketball.
Chris Bosh has been fined for flopping in basketball.
In golf, a "flop shot" is a high-trajectory shot.
